 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 12-03-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Umeshanand Pandit, learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends her arrest in a complaint case punishable for the offence under Sections 498A, 494 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Petitioner happens to be second wife of husband of the complainant.
Specific accusation is against husband of the complainant.
So far as this petitioner is concerned, she has been implicated in this case merely because she happens to be second wife of husband of the complainant.
There is general and omnibus allegation.
Complainant has not alleged any specific accusation against this petitioner.
Petitioner is lady and has got clean antecedent.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.12939 of 2024(2) dt.12-03-2024 4.
Learned A.P.P. for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, let the above named petitioner be enlarged on bail on furnishing Kanchan Kumari vs The State Of Bihar on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110885020/
1 bail-bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M. - II, Samastipur in connection with Complaint Case No. 1476 of 2022, T.R. No. 2492 of 2023, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
 (Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
